requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:54 matches the contract signature; :58 `empty($webhookUrl)` returns before any HTTP call for null/''; :75 `Http::timeout(5)->post($webhookUrl, ['content' => $text])`; :62-68 title/message/`key=value` lines joined with "\n"; :70-71 mb_substr to 1800; :135-146 case-insensitive key match with _/- normalised (covers api_key/api-key/apikey); :148-151 Bearer regex; :122-129 recursive redaction, JSON rendering at :96; :79-88 non-2xx and Throwable both logged via Log::error, the exception message is scrubbed of the URL and the status path logs only `status`. config/logging.php:171 stack defaults to daily, :179-185 audit channel (daily, logs/audit.log, level info, 90 days); config/services.php:198-200; phpunit.xml:279; .env.example:10-15,25; docs/ops/logging.md added. The diff does not touch the daily channel itself; the test at tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:424-426 asserts days=14, which suggests the existing stock config already reads LOG_DAILY_DAYS.

conventions.evidence: The class lives at the location the task requires, with no extra service layers. Docs are kept in sync (docs/ops/logging.md, CHANGELOG.md:34 under Added). The new public method `send()` has no PHPDoc (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:54), but conventions ask for PHPDoc on public methods touched.

security.evidence: Webhook URL is never logged: the non-2xx path logs only `status` (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:80-82), and the exception path uses `scrub()` (:86, :153-160). Redaction covers sensitive keys recursively and Bearer values regardless of key (:112-133). No user-facing input or Livewire surface.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php covers container resolution, the null/empty no-op (:304-317), content format, URL and method (:319-336), exact 1800 truncation (:338-349), key/bearer/nested redaction (:351-397) and logging config (:423-433). However, the two failure tests named 'without webhook url' / 'scrubs url' (:399-421) only assert `shouldHaveReceived('error')->once()` and never check that the logged message/context lacks the URL. The audit test (:435-439) asserts `expect(true)->toBeTrue()`.

simplicity.evidence: A single ~118-line class with small private helpers (renderValue, redact, isSensitiveKey, containsBearer, scrub). It uses the Http/Log facades and the existing config files. There are no abstractions beyond what the task needs.

readability.evidence: Methods are clear and focused with descriptive names (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:91-160). Config entries match sibling style (`replace_placeholders` at config/logging.php:184). No dead code or debug output.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task (.env.example, CHANGELOG, class, logging/services config, docs, phpunit.xml, test). The notifier is not wired into any job or handler, which is correctly left out of scope.

issues.explanation: The soft-fail tests promise 'without webhook url' / 'scrubs url' but only assert that error() was called once; they never check that the log message or context omits the webhook URL, so the scrubbing is untested.
The audit-channel write test asserts `expect(true)->toBeTrue()`, which proves nothing beyond 'did not throw'.
The public `send()` method has no PHPDoc describing redaction, truncation and soft-fail behaviour, which conventions ask for on public methods.
The daily channel is not shown in the diff, so its LOG_DAILY_DAYS/14 configuration is only verified indirectly through the config test.

review.summary: The change adds a soft-failing, redacting, truncating DiscordOpsAlert notifier, the audit logging channel, a daily-backed default stack, env keys and a clear lane decision guide. It meets the contract cleanly and stays in scope. The main weaknesses are in the tests: the failure-path tests do not actually assert that the webhook URL is absent from logs, and the audit test is a no-op assertion. These are worth tightening but do not block approval.
